cards.mood: The piece opens with an atmospheric and mystical tension that quickly erupts into a high-energy, aggressive drive.
cards.palette: Distorted electric guitars provide the core harmonic weight and rhythmic chugging throughout the track, excluding the very brief intro.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Shadows stretch across the frozen stone
Ancient spirits wake within the bone
A thousand years of silence start to break
The sleeping earth begins to shake
[Pre-Chorus]
Steel meets skin in the driving rain
Blood flows hot through every vein
[Chorus]
Rise above the mountain's crown
Where the golden banners fly down
Fight the fire, face the fear
Now the destiny is clear
[Verse]
Shields collide like drums in the night
One final stand for the holy light
The dragon's breath turns the valley gray
No man shall turn his head away

Steel meets skin in the driving rain

[Chorus]
Rise above the mountain's crown
Where the golden banners fly down
Fight the fire, face the fear

[Bridge]

Where the weary and the brave lie
[Chorus]

Where the golden banners fly down
Fight the fire, face the fear
Now the destiny is clear
[Outro]
